supporting_spans: The Emergency Wetlands Resources Act of 1986 requires the Secretary of the Interior, through the Director of the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, to map the nation's wetlands. It further requires the Secretary to produce national wetlands status and trends reports to Congress.
